name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_choice
label: ccs_v12_exact_85_control
proof:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  rw [HomBisimilarity.symm_simulation]
  refine ⟨_, ChoiceBisim.choice h, ⟨?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · grind only [ChoiceBisim, → Bisimilarity.symm]
  · rintro a b (h | h) μ c ht
    cases ht
    case choiceR => exact ⟨c, .choiceR ‹_›, .bisim (.refl _)⟩
    all_goals
      exact (h.follow_fst ‹_›).imp fun _ =>
        And.imp (by first | exact id | exact Tr.choiceL) ChoiceBisim.bisim
